verdict.rationale: Featurebase's own docs say it centralizes feedback into a single source of truth through a feedback portal, in-app widgets and integrations, and its API can return all feedback posts for an organization. However, nothing shows the repository is searchable; the only search evidence covers help-center AI answers, which is a different feature. Nothing shows colleagues' internal requests being captured alongside customer feedback either. Missing for 10: documented search/filter over the feedback repository, explicit internal-colleague request capture, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a product-manager, I can access one searchable repository for all product requests and feedback from colleagues and customers

citations.quote: Centralize insights to a single source of truth with a feedback portal, in-app widgets, and integrations.
Returns all posts (feedback submissions) for the authenticated organization.
